_about: Human-owned. Studio fit per family (default) and per item (override). fit: direct = useful on this rig or in a current pipeline now; adjacent = touches our domain, worth using when the need arises; general = field knowledge, no studio use expected. Reviewed 2026-10-07 against catalog ref 67a13c0b.

accelerated-computing.note: cuDF: GPU pandas. Worth it only if a dataset/manifest job gets CPU-bound.

amc.note: Camera calibration stack for video analytics.

bionemo.note: Drug discovery and protein models (NIMs, KERMT). Several send inputs to NVIDIA-hosted APIs.

cuopt.note: GPU LP/MILP/routing solver. Conceivably useful for scheduling/allocation puzzles; no current need.

dali.note: GPU data loading for training pipelines.

data-designer.note: Synthetic dataset pipelines. Relevant to dialogue/voice/eval datasets; confirm it can run on local models (Standing Rule 1) before use.

digital-health.note: Clinical ASR flywheel; the build/eval/finetune loop is a reusable pattern for any domain ASR.

doca.note: BlueField DPU / ConnectX networking. Data-center infrastructure.

dynamo.note: Kubernetes LLM serving (KV-aware routing, disaggregated serving). Not for a single-GPU rig; possibly for offrig pods.

g-assist.note: Reads/changes this machine's display and GPU settings via MCP. Read-only use is fine; changes are system settings and need the Director's say-so.

jetson.note: Jetson BSP/flash/customize and edge LLM serving. The LLM benchmark/serve skills are good references for local-serving method.

nemo-mbridge.note: Megatron Bridge large-scale training performance (parallelism, MoE, CUDA graphs).

nemo-relay.note: Instrumentation/observability middleware for LLM and tool calls. Compare against Role OS and swarm receipts before adopting anything.

nemo-retriever.note: Document ingestion + search (local LanceDB) with an MCP. A candidate upgrade path if this seat outgrows SQLite FTS5.

nemo-rl.note: RL post-training. See item notes: two skills are worth reading as patterns.

nemotron.note: Nemotron speech (ASR/TTS), voice agents, customization recipes. Relevant to voice work; self-hosted NIMs only.

nvidia.note: NVIDIA App / Broadcast MCPs and the skill finder.

omniverse.note: OpenUSD performance and CAD-to-SimReady. USD knowledge may serve the UE5 projects' asset pipeline.

paidf.note: Physical-AI data factory on Kubernetes (Cosmos augmentation, auto-labeling).

physical-ai.note: Synthetic-data generation infrastructure for physical AI.

portfolio.note: Finance portfolio optimization with cuOpt. Field knowledge only; nobody acts on it as advice.

rag.note: RAG blueprint, evaluation (RAGAS) and load testing. rag-eval is the useful one for judging any retrieval we build.

rtx-remix.note: RTX Remix via MCP: remaster classic DX8/9 games by swapping textures/models. Not our engine path, but a live example of an AI-assisted asset-swap pipeline.

skill.note: Governance skill cards for agent skills.

tao.note: TAO vision-model training platform. A few single-model skills overlap our visual pipeline (see items).

tilegym.note: cuTile kernel authoring, autotuning, Triton conversion. The kit to pick up if the studio ever writes a custom GPU kernel.

warp.note: NVIDIA Warp (Python GPU simulation). warp-eval judges whether a slow loop is a Warp candidate.

nvidia-skill-finder.note: The router: on NVIDIA-flavoured work it checks the live catalogue and recommends at most three skills, never installing without approval. The one install candidate; registered as an instrument.

g-assist-mcp-skill.note: Needs the G-Assist MCP running. Read GPU/display state freely; never change settings without the Director.

nvidia-app.note: Driver checks through the NVIDIA App MCP. Useful for 'is the driver current' questions on the rig.

tilegym-cutile-python.note: Entry point for writing cuTile kernels. Pair with entry 2026-10-07-cuda-python-ecosystem.

tilegym-improve-cutile-kernel-perf.note: Profiling-driven kernel tuning loop; pairs with Nsight Copilot.

warp-eval.note: Run before porting any CPU hot path (texture projection, particle/geometry loops) to the GPU.

tao-train-depth-anything-v2.note: Depth Anything v2 — the depth model family our 2.5D/ControlNet work already leans on. Training-side only; inference lives in ComfyUI.

tao-finetune-clip.note: CLIP fine-tune/embeddings: relevant to style scoring and curation (ai-eyes, sdlab).

tao-generate-image-embeddings.note: CLIP/SigLIP embeddings over an image list: the first step of dataset dedup and near-neighbour curation.

tao-mine-nearest-neighbors.note: Near-neighbour mining over embeddings: dataset curation.

tao-train-mask-auto-label.note: Masks from point/box hints: sprite matte/segmentation research.

nemo-rl-auto-research.note: Read as a pattern for this seat's tuning grids: baseline first; one hypothesis per git branch, failed branches kept; a TSV ledger row per run (branch, parent commit, metric, memory, minutes, command, log path, keep/discard/crash); explicit stop rules re-checked after each run; never discard an idea on an underpowered smoke run. The NeMo-RL and Kubernetes parts do not apply on one 5090.

nemo-rl-session-memory.note: Read as a pattern: durable session memory for coding agents; compare with loadout-os.

nemo-mbridge-perf-cuda-graphs.note: CUDA graph capture at training scale; see entry 2026-10-07-cuda-graphs.

jetson-llm-benchmark.note: Structured-JSON benchmarking across vLLM/llama.cpp/Ollama; the method transfers to engine-room measurement.

rag-eval.note: RAGAS quality benchmark harness: use to judge any retrieval layer before trusting it.

physical-ai-neural-reconstruction.note: NuRec/3D Gaussian splatting router (sensor sim). Field knowledge for 3DGS.

tao-finetune-huggingface-model.note: Read 2026-10-08 for the Kev and critic fine-tunes. Worth taking as rules: a 1-step smoke on real data must show finite loss and grad_norm > 0 before any full run; minimal-change error recovery (OOM: halve batch, double grad accumulation, gradient checkpointing; NaN: LR / 10; same error 3 times: stop); fetch live model-card and library docs instead of writing trainer code from memory; zero-shot baseline eval before training; emit a rerun skill per run. Not adopted as a tool: it needs Docker plus nvidia-container-toolkit and an NGC image, and defaults to push_to_hub=True, against the studio's private-first rule.

data-designer.note: NeMo Data Designer: synthetic datasets as column pipelines (samplers, LLM text columns, LLM-judge columns holding {reasoning, score}, validators, seed datasets). Matches how the critic controls are planted and judged, but the studio's bespoke builders already pin models and log failures per item; reconsider for a new dataset build rather than port the existing ones. Local-endpoint support unverified.

nemotron-customize.note: A planner over the Nemotron repo's step catalogue (curation, SFT/PEFT, DPO/GRPO, conversion, eval). Needs that repo checked out and remote env profiles; its peft/automodel route is the only part sized for a small box. No studio use expected now.
